_note: v2 hook overrides for le Sentier du Ciel Changeant (ST_ciel, S16_park), a showery spring-to-harvest meadow path of turf-roofed cottages; distinct from the Observatoire & météo (B32_ciel). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the one reflexive verb (s'épanouir).

fr_pleuvoir_verb.why: PLOP of the rain → pleuvoir = to rain. Impersonal: only the il form exists (il pleut, il a plu, il pleuvra), so the card shows il forms only and no imperative. GOLD beret = irregular (il pleut).

fr_couler_verb.why: COOL water → couler = to flow (la rivière coule vers la mer); also to sink (le bateau coule). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_luire_verb.why: LURE gleaming in the dark → luire = to shine, gleam (les yeux du chat luisent dans le noir). GOLD beret = irregular (il luit, ils luisent; past participle lui).

fr_briller_verb.why: Brilliant → briller = to shine (le soleil brille). RED beret = regular -er. Oct30 1b: BRILLIANT was a cognate and the sun is outside the box; a shining Brie wedge was crop-edited into his hand.

fr_ensoleiller_verb.why: En + soleil (sun) → ensoleiller = to fill with sunshine, to brighten up (ce sourire ensoleille ma journée). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_rallumer_verb.why: Re + allumer (to light, from lumière) → rallumer = to relight, switch back on (il rallume la lampe). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_eclaircir_verb.why: CLEAR → éclaircir = to brighten, to clear (he clears the sky himself, so it is plain éclaircir: no mirror; the sky clearing on its own is le ciel s'éclaircit). GREEN beret = regular -ir (nous éclaircissons).

fr_polir_verb.why: Polish → polir = to polish (il polit les vieilles cuillères en argent). GREEN beret = regular -ir (nous polissons).

fr_dorer_verb.why: D'or (of gold) → dorer = to gild, to make golden; in the kitchen faire dorer = to brown (faites dorer les oignons). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_epanouir_verb.why: S'épanouir = to bloom, to blossom (les roses s'épanouissent au soleil); used reflexively, so he holds the hand mirror and takes être (elles se sont épanouies). GREEN beret = regular -ir (nous nous épanouissons).

fr_exasperer_verb.why: Exasperate → exaspérer = to exasperate (ses retards m'exaspèrent). RED beret = regular -er. (j'exaspère, nous exaspérons).

fr_cherir_verb.why: CHERRY / cherish → chérir = to cherish (elle chérit ses souvenirs d'enfance). GREEN beret = regular -ir (nous chérissons).

fr_fleurir_verb.why: Fleur (flower), flourish → fleurir = to flower, to bloom (les cerisiers fleurissent au printemps). GREEN beret = regular -ir (nous fleurissons).

fr_tacher_verb_2.why: Mous-TACHE → tacher = to stain (le café a taché ma chemise); une tache = a stain. Not to be confused with tâcher (with ^) = to try. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_mouiller_verb.why: MOIST → mouiller = to wet, to make wet (la pluie mouille mes cheveux). RED beret = regular -er. (je mouille, nous mouillons).
fr_mouiller_verb.note: Also has a sexual slang sense, so watch out for jokes.

fr_planer_verb.why: PLANE (glider) → planer = to glide, to hover (l'aigle plane au-dessus de la vallée). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_feuilleter_verb.why: Feuille (leaf, page) → feuilleter = to leaf through (elle feuillette un magazine). RED beret = regular -er. (je feuillette, nous feuilletons).

fr_couver_verb.why: COVER → couver = to brood, sit on eggs (la poule couve ses œufs); also to coddle. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_piloter_verb.why: Pilot → piloter = to pilot, to fly or drive (il pilote un petit avion). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_inonder_verb.why: Inundate → inonder = to flood (la rivière a inondé les champs). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_aerer_verb.why: Air, aerate → aérer = to air (ouvre la fenêtre pour aérer la chambre). RED beret = regular -er. (j'aère, nous aérons).

fr_deborder_verb.why: Dé + bord (edge, BORDER) → déborder = to overflow (la rivière déborde après la pluie). RED beret = regular -er.
